transport.title: Free Q70 LGA Link
transport.hint: To the subway from B and C
transport.text: The free Q70 LGA Link bus serves Terminals B and C and connects the airport with the subway interchanges Jackson Heights–Roosevelt Avenue and 74 St–Broadway. MTA buses are wheelchair accessible and equipped with ramps.

taxi.title: Taxi
taxi.text: Taxis are available at all terminals without advance booking: a dispatcher directs passengers from the queue to an available car. Fares are based on distance and time, with an initial meter amount of USD 3; a USD 2 PANYNJ fee also applies to airport pick-ups. Wheelchair-accessible taxis cost the same as regular taxis and can be requested on +1 646 599 9999.

terminals.title: All Terminals Shuttle
terminals.text: The free All Terminals Shuttle runs between all terminals and also stops at the prepaid Economy Lot (Parking Lot 7), Hangar 7 South and 94th Street. It operates round the clock: every 15 minutes during peak periods and every 20 minutes at other times.

wifi.title: Free Wi-Fi
wifi.text: For free access, select _Free LGA WiFi. Support is available round the clock on +1 800 880 4117.
